notes.title: 3 new bosses - Big Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[h1]Big update coming soon[/h1]

New features, new game mechanics and enhanced gameplay is in the making, should be ready soon!

If you haven't been following on my [url=https://www.indiedb.com/members/gtgames]Dev blog over at Indie DB[/url] then no worries, I will be posting all the news here on Steam from now on as well. The first of the content I want to share with you guys is the new bosses you can expect in the update. Let me introduce them to you...





[i]The screenshots are meant to give you a teaser look at the boss, but if you prefer spoilers there are full animated gifs of the boss fights at the bottom, check em out![/i]

[h2]Jelly G:[/h2]
The psyched up jelly creature does not like the fact that you are eliminating his lesser jelly comrades. Nicknamed Jelly G as he is believed to be the leader of the Jelly Gang. Juan has managed to get on the bad side of the most powerful slime monster in existence, now you gotta fight him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/d57842f297986d590bd045cb6a0ab1aa7faad74b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/96ef90694a33dbf4f2c38b4fa45910981d6d9ec2.png[/img]

[h2]Big Roar:[/h2]
A big ogre known for nothing more than his big roar. Nothing has lived to tell what the creature looks like that creates the roar, which is why he is named after the sound he makes that causes all living creatures in the area to run away before he comes to take his next victim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/7737110ae6ea943603009ec43b4ceaf28d21344f.png[/img]

[h2]Dune Breaker:[/h2]
A massive and territorial worm-like monster of unknown origins. Legend has it that this ancient creature has been feasting off the underground world for a millennium, becoming the most unstoppable being from the deep dunes of the desert. This giant creature must occasional resurface to sleep, as it can't breath very well underground. If you cause too much vibrations near this monsters resting place, it will sense you and come up to the surface and get rid of you the only way it knows how, by swallowing you whole!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/b1adac4a011b480fc177224342b33ec008659366.png[/img]


You can check out the Dev Blog on Indie DB for more detailed info and links to higher quality GIFs.

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/members/gtgames]Dev Log[/url]

Or you can wish list and follow here on Steam, as all existing and future Dev Log updates will now be shared here.

[h1]SPOILER GIFS BELOW[/h1]
Here are some animated gifs of the boss fights, they are spoiler rich but if you don't mind, I would love it if you checked them out.

notes.title: Bug Fixes (B#1.09)
notes.notes:
B#1.09:

-Fixed water gap glitch

-Fixed bug where some preferences would not save

-Fixed bug that caused the block button not to trigger in some circumstances

-Fixed bug that caused some enemies to hit you after it had already been defeated

-Added mission prompt to tell you when you need to go back to town for key upgrades.

notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.notes:
This updates features a new wider field of view, now the game will look much better on wide displays! Also featured are some other graphical improvements...

[h1]WIDER SCREEN[/h1]
The game will now fill your entire screen, making for a  wider and nicer looking field of view! 

[h2]BEFORE:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/d93fb4af80badf448184ae9e3ed97e2ad5db89be.png[/img]

[h2]AFTER:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/b8868da4481f071f99889bf2a812645fddb81ea0.png[/img]


This not only makes the game look easier on the eyes, but also increases the range of support for different display resolutions.

[h1]BLOOM[/h1]
Also, you will notice the environment looking a bit more soft and vivid with the new Bloom graphics mode, it will make that new sunshine over the hills look real nice!
[i]On by default, you can toggle this setting in the Preferences menu. [/i]

[h1]V-Sync[/h1]
Sometimes the smallest of things can make the biggest difference, a simple V-sync method willl reduce screen tearing on some computers. 
[i]This setting may not work optimally on all devices, if this new setting causes performance issues it is recommended that you turn it off in the Preferences menu.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/d04c95eb2fa82b77ef72372df102d60ab14759d3.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce, that the game will be released on 06/17! Release is coming a little later than intended, but the extra time has allowed us to test and polish the game even more!

[h3]Release Date: 06/17/2022[/h3]

[h1]______________________________[/h1]

notes.title: Progress going good, game coming soon!
notes.notes:
The progress of the game is coming along well, and the game should be ready for release sometime in April!

In the meantime, here is a screenshot of the Info Menu, which will show you information about items and upgrades you have collected in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41943901/cb0e91c74442528768b3302669da28147e1cd783.png[/img]

When you select an item, an info box will appear and give a brief description of the item selected. This menu will also show your current Mission info and any temporary Buffs that are active!
